title: The Discipline of Controlled Evidence
text:
Scientists often rely on controlled experiments to establish cause and effect. By changing one variable at a time and keeping the others constant, researchers can observe whether a particular factor truly influences the outcome. Without such controls, apparent patterns may simply reflect coincidence.

However, a single experiment rarely settles a question. Replication by independent teams is essential, because it reduces the chance that an unusual result stems from error or bias. Over time, a body of consistent findings can justify a broader theory.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do researchers do to test whether a factor influences an outcome?
options: They change one variable at a time while keeping the others constant
They rely on coincidence to explain patterns
They publish results before any replication
They avoid controls in order to save time

questions.text: What does the second paragraph say is essential?
options: Single experiments with very large samples

questions.text: What can be inferred about a result that has never been replicated?
options: It may be unreliable, because it could stem from error or bias
It proves that the related theory is wrong
It is more reliable than a replicated result

questions.text: What is the author's implied view of a single experiment?
options: It is rarely enough to settle a question on its own
It is the most important source of knowledge
It proves cause and effect immediately

vocabulary.definition: managed or tested under fixed conditions
a factor that can change during an experiment
a situation where things happen together by chance
staying the same or agreeing with other results

paragraph_translations: Науковці часто покладаються на контрольовані експерименти, щоб встановити причинно-наслідковий зв'язок. Змінюючи одну змінну за раз і утримуючи інші сталими, дослідники можуть перевірити, чи справді певний чинник впливає на результат. Без таких контролів очевидні закономірності можуть бути лише випадковістю.

Однак один експеримент рідко остаточно вирішує питання. Відтворення результатів незалежними командами є необхідним, оскільки воно зменшує ймовірність того, що незвичайний результат є наслідком помилки або упередженості. З часом сукупність послідовних висновків може обґрунтувати ширшу теорію.
